name: Sacrifice: Bringer
summary: • When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder on a boss enemy, all squad members gain 1 stack of Laser Focus, stacking up to 6 times. Each stack of Laser Focus increases the Agent's ATK by 8%. With at least 3 stacks of Laser Focus, inflicting an Attribute Anomaly will increase its duration by 5s. When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.

appearances.description: • When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder on a boss enemy, all squad members gain Laser Focus, which stacks up to 6 times. Each stack of Laser Focus increases the agent's CRIT Rate by 5%. When having at least 3 stacks of Laser Focus, inflicting an Attribute Anomaly will increase its duration by 5s. When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.
appearances.performance: • Successfully interrupting a chant grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.
